questions.question: What is the average reported PCE of n-i-p perovskite solar cells using SnO2 as the ETL?

provenance.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(JV_default_PCE) FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture='nip' AND ETL_stack_sequence LIKE '%SnO2%' AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL

questions.tolerance_note: count within 5% (NULL-PCE filter variants); mean within 5%

questions.question: What are the 10 most frequently reported HTL materials in n-i-p perovskite solar cells with PCE above 20%?

provenance.sql: SELECT HTL_stack_sequence, COUNT(*) FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture='nip' AND JV_default_PCE > 20 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Compare the reported PCE distributions of p-i-n and n-i-p perovskite solar cells in the database. Report the number of records and the mean and median PCE for each architecture.

provenance.sql: SELECT Cell_architecture, JV_default_PCE FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture IN ('nip','pin') AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL

questions.notes: Values must be attached to the right architecture (window match).

questions.question: Among n-i-p perovskite solar cells using SnO2 as the ETL, identify the highest-PCE reported devices and report their HTL, absorber/material stack, PCE, Voc, Jsc and FF.

provenance.sql: SELECT Ref_DOI_number, HTL_stack_sequence, ETL_stack_sequence, Perovskite_composition_long_form, JV_default_PCE, JV_default_Voc, JV_default_Jsc, JV_default_FF FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture='nip' AND ETL_stack_sequence LIKE '%SnO2%' AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY JV_default_PCE DESC LIMIT 5

questions.notes: The maximum is a database entry with implausible Jsc (data-quality issue); the reference is what the database reports.
